newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades American General.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades American General.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded American General Corp to neutral from outperform. -- The brokerage cut its fourth quarter operating earnings per share estimate to $0.75 a share from $0.85, and dropped its full-year 1997 operating estimate to $3.50 from $3.65. -- "Consumer finance results continue to disappoint, and our sense is that life insurance earnings excluding acquisitions will be weaker than we previously expected," a Lehman summary report said.
